title: Flap Support Rib — Web Crack Repair by Bonded Doubler

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Wing Trailing Edge — Flap Support Structure

abstract: Repair of a crack in the web of a flap support rib by a bonded and riveted doubler, applicable only where the crack does not reach the carriage pin bore boss.

sections.purpose: This repair restores the shear capability of a flap support rib web after a crack has been stopped and the damaged material removed.
sections.damage_assessment: Cracks in this web start at the lower fastener row and grow inboard towards the pin bore boss. Establish the crack extent by dye penetrant inspection with the flap extended and the rib cleaned, and confirm the tip position by eddy current. A crack whose tip is within 25 mm of the pin bore boss is outside the scope of this repair, because the doubler footprint would overlap the boss fillet and the load path there is not covered by the substantiation. Measure the crack length and the tip position relative to the lower flange and record both. Where the same rib has already been repaired, this repair may not be applied a second time.
sections.repair_procedure: Extend the flap fully and support it on the carriage cradle. Remove the trailing edge lower panel and clean the rib web. Stop-drill each crack tip to the diameter given on repair drawing RD-57-30-12-905 and ream the stop-drill hole. Do a dye penetrant inspection of the stop-drill hole and confirm that the crack tip is fully removed; repeat the stop-drill at the next larger diameter if it is not. Prepare the bonding surface on both faces of the web over the doubler footprint. Cut the doubler to the layout on the drawing and drill the fastener pattern using the doubler as a template. Install the doubler on the inboard face with the structural adhesive and rivets EN545167-02, and add the outboard packer where the doubler crosses the shear tie D5730118419315. Apply the surface protection to all new surfaces. Where the repair reaches the cleat BRDE298405-27 land, seal the joint edge rather than fastening through the cleat. Install the trailing edge panel and do the flap drive system test and the flap position rigging check.
sections.inspection_requirements: The repair is life limited to 9 000 flight cycles from the date of embodiment. Do a repeat dye penetrant inspection of the stop-drill holes and an eddy current inspection of the doubler perimeter every 2 500 flight cycles. The carriage pin bore borescope inspection remains due at its own interval and is not replaced by this repair. Report the repair to Aeralis with the crack length and the tip position at the finding.

type_data.allowable_damage_limits: Web cracks up to 30 mm in length whose tip is more than 25 mm from the carriage pin bore boss and more than 15 mm from a fastener centre. One repair per rib, once only.

repair_drawings.title: Bonded and riveted web doubler, flap support rib

type_data.fastener_pattern: Two rows of 22 rivets around the doubler perimeter, 20 mm pitch, 14 mm edge distance
type_data.fatigue_life_note: Repair is life limited to 9 000 flight cycles; repeat dye penetrant and eddy current inspection every 2 500 flight cycles.
